lines.beaver_en: Hello, this is Hana Travel. How can I help you?
lines.learner: 서울 여행을 가고 싶어요. 외국에서 왔어요.
lines.en: I want to travel in Seoul. I came from abroad.
lines.roman: Seoul yeohaengeul gago sipeoyo. Oegugeseo wasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Nice to meet you. How many days will you travel?
lines.learner: 삼 일이요. 다음 주 월요일에 서울에 와요.
lines.en: Three days. I come to Seoul next Monday.
lines.roman: Sam iriyo. Daeum ju woryoire seoure wayo.

lines.beaver_en: Where would you like to go?
lines.learner: 박물관에 가고 남대문 시장도 보고 싶어요.
lines.en: I want to go to a museum and see Namdaemun Market.
lines.roman: Bangmulgwane gago namdaemun sijangdo bogo sipeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Good. It's best to go to the museum early.
lines.learner: 네, 아침에 일찍 가고 오후에 시장에 갈게요.
lines.en: Okay, I'll go early in the morning and the market in the afternoon.
lines.roman: Ne, achime iljjik gago ohue sijange galgeyo.

lines.learner: 아니요, 아직 안 했어요. 어떤 호텔이 좋아요?
lines.en: No, not yet. Which hotel is good?
lines.roman: Aniyo, ajik an haesseoyo. Eotteon hoteri joayo?

lines.beaver_en: Near Dongdaemun is cheap. The market is close too.
lines.learner: 동대문 호텔이 좋아요. 쇼핑하고 쉬고 싶어요.
lines.en: A Dongdaemun hotel sounds good. I want to shop and rest.
lines.roman: Dongdaemun hoteri joayo. Syopinghago swigo sipeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then I'll book a Dongdaemun hotel for you.
lines.en: Thank you. My name is Michael Brown.

lines.beaver_en: Please write your name and phone number here.
lines.learner: 네, 다 썼어요. 여행사가 친절하고 좋네요.
lines.en: Okay, all done. This travel agency is kind and nice.
lines.roman: Ne, da sseosseoyo. Yeohaengsaga chinjeolhago jonneyo.

lines.beaver_en: Thank you. Pack your things light.
lines.learner: 네, 오늘 밤에 가방을 싸고 일찍 잘게요.
lines.en: Okay, I'll pack my bag tonight and sleep early.
lines.roman: Ne, oneul bame gabangeul ssago iljjik jalgeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Have a good trip. Come again!
lines.learner: 고맙습니다. 여행하고 다시 올게요. 안녕히 계세요.
lines.en: Thank you. I'll travel and come back. Goodbye.
lines.roman: Gomapseumnida. Yeohaenghago dasi olgeyo. Annyeonghi gyeseyo.
